n72ap-5F138.triage: (a)+(c) 2.1.1 through the app pipeline (ipod-2x): prepare needed only the catalog recipe block (the Swift n72 recipe already had the 2.x paths: no BuildManifest, plain-tail img3, epoch-1 NAND, only iBoot's SHSH wrapped, no iBoot.bin, no helpers/seed package without the shared cache); boot needed the lock's boot_strategy "bootrom" (SecureROM -> NOR LLB -> iBoot; the app and the session driver passed a missing iBoot.bin as direct-iboot) and the session driver setting the time over lockdown-tz as the app does (clears lockdownd's BrickState; before it the screen sat on Connect to iTunes). Home screen, Activated, AFC 4/4, persist. Byte-matched to qemu-ios ipod2g_device.py: nor.bin, gid-blobs.bin, identity.json identical; the system volumes list the same 10801 entries with equal contents except the SpringBoard job plist (same content, different binary-plist encoding) and lockdownd (same patched code; the signature blob differs, ldid vs FirmwareKit). Shutdown passes since qemu-ios ipod-2x-hold 19649e467c (smoke #19, closed): the hold button was never the gap (the 2.x DeviceTree has function-button_hold <gpio 0x0c02> like 3.x; Hold locks the screen). Two gaps in the machine's hold-and-slide: (1) it held Home through the 2.5 s settle and pressed Hold in the same tick as the release, so both edges arrived in one GPIO status read (group 3 = 0x06000000) and 2.x's SpringBoard never raised the power-off sheet (from a dark lock screen the first press only wakes the display, which hid it); Home is now a tap. (2) 2.x's AppleD1759PMU-36.2 halt, tethered, prints "pmu waiting for stdby" and sleeps on the PMU interrupt until the cable comes out (EVENT_A bit 3 -> 0x0a bit 0), where 3.x/4.x's -94.7 writes 0x6f=0x90; the gesture now unplugs once the guest has turned the backlight rail off. Earlier rows (ipod-2x 43f7aff9ac) failed shutdown only. Rows from qemu-ios ipod-2x 43f7aff9ac (bd8d6b1363 + the 0x38100000 block); 5F138 also passes everything but shutdown on the pinned bd8d6b1363.
